title: Affine formal morphism realization
statement: Let $Y$ be a Noetherian scheme, $J$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf and $G,H$ coherent formal $J$-adic module systems with morphism $\alpha:G\to H$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. For each affine open $U$ put $B=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Y)$ and $R=\widehat B_{J(U)}$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. There exist coherent modules $A,D$ on $\operatorname{Spec}R$ [pqf-def-coherent], a map $c:A\to D$ and $B$-module isomorphisms $e_A:\varprojlim\Gamma(U,G_n)\to\operatorname{Res}_B^R\Gamma(A)$ and $e_D:\varprojlim\Gamma(U,H_n)\to\operatorname{Res}_B^R\Gamma(D)$ such that $(\varprojlim\alpha_n)e_D=e_A\operatorname{Res}_B^R\Gamma(c)$ (composition in Lean order).

source.place: Lemma 087W, natural affine equivalence and finite-module tilde correspondence (01XZ)

proof.text: Use coherentFormalModule_affine_limit_model on U. Its equivalence and natural comparison provide finite completed modules N,M, the image v of alpha, and B-linear limit isomorphisms natural in alpha. The open subscheme is Noetherian and its affine coordinate ring is Noetherian.

The completion R is Noetherian. Finite R-modules have finite presentations (Mathlib Module.finitePresentation_of_finite); apply presentationTilde to a finite generator/relation presentation. Its IsFinite witness implies finite presentation of the tilde sheaf, hence quasi-coherence and finite type. The locally Noetherian coherence criterion gives coherent A=tilde(N), D=tilde(M).

Set c=tilde(v). Compose the affine-model comparison components with restriction of scalars applied to the tilde/Gamma unit components. Naturality of the affine-model comparison and of the tilde/Gamma unit, functoriality of restriction of scalars and associativity give the commuting square.

lean.statement:
theorem formal_affine_morphism_realization
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Y] (J : Y.IdealSheafData)
    (G H : CoherentFormalModule Y J) (α : G ⟶ H) :
    ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
      let B := Γ(Y, U.1)
      let R := AdicCompletion (J.ideal U) B
      ∃ (A D : CoherentModules (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (c : A.obj ⟶ D.obj),
        ∃ eA : limit (G.obj ⋙ SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)) ≅
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B R)).obj
              ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj A.obj),
        ∃ eD : limit (H.obj ⋙
              SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1)) ≅
            (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B R)).obj
              ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).obj D.obj),
          lim.map (Functor.whiskerRight α.hom
            (SheafOfModules.evaluation Y.ringCatSheaf (op U.1))) ≫ eD.hom =
          eA.hom ≫ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap B R)).map
            ((moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of R)).map c)
